purpose: Identity and location of every EMBER V1 checkpoint. Weights are NOT in Git. Each identity record below is tracked compact evidence; scripts/verify_checkpoint.py hashes a local copy against it.

base_model.access: public Hugging Face model; revision confirmed to exist on 2026-11-13
base_model.note: Every checkpoint is a LoRA adapter plus a float32 Clef joint head on this frozen base. The tokenizer files ship inside each actor directory.

evidence_roots.note: Historical RTX 5090 workstation paths. They are not reachable from a fresh clone. Copy the needed directories to a local evidence root and verify them before use.

checkpoints.name: p1-18-v1-train@1
checkpoints.role: Original SFT-trained V1 student; frozen parent of every RL run
checkpoints.verify: env -u HF_TOKEN PYTHONPATH=src python -m ember_v1.hfstore verify p1-18-v1-train@1
checkpoints.fetch: env -u HF_TOKEN PYTHONPATH=src python -m ember_v1.hfstore fetch p1-18-v1-train@1 --dest <empty-dir>
checkpoints.load: Pass the fetched directory as --model-root to ember_v1.rl_run / rl_online / rl_cf_run, or as checkpoint= to ember_v1.rl_ppo.V1Actor.

availability.evidence: hfstore verify: 14 files at revision 1fc405f7, 4 LFS sha256 + 10 git sha1 metadata checks, 13 content checks, 0 problems
availability.access: Read access to the private Hugging Face repo sankalphs/ember-v1-models (hf auth login as an account with access).
